summary: Refactor regression suite (iter 17): 23/27 passed (85%), 3 failed (all NameError from missing imports in refactored sub-modules), 1 skipped (downstream of register failure). The package-split refactor works for the majority of endpoints — login, /auth/me, /auth/verify-pin, all /wallet/* (GET, transactions, withdraw, p2p, recharge-qr), all /transfers/* (fx-rate, draft, list, get, receipt-pdf PDF generation OK, validate-code), /agent/me + /agent/dashboard (403 for non-agent), and all web_panels (/api/web/, /api/web/admin, /api/web/superadmin, /api/web/partner). WebSocket routes /api/ws/auction/{id} and /api/ws/agent are properly registered (verified via app.routes introspection). 3 CRITICAL regression bugs found — missing module-level imports caused by AST extraction not copying all `from ... import ...` lines into each split file: (1) routers/auth/core.py — POST /auth/register → 500 NameError: notify_signup_otp (also IS_PROD); (2) routers/auth/password.py — POST /auth/forgot-password → 500 NameError: create_reset_token (also decode_token, jwt, notify_password_reset, IS_PROD); (3) routers/agent/core.py — POST /agent/signup → 500 NameError: hash_password. Two additional latent bugs found by code review (not test-exercised because demo client already has PIN/credentials): (4) routers/auth/pin.py — is_weak_pin used but not imported (will break POST /auth/create-pin); (5) routers/web_panels/admin.py & agent_admin.py — `_dt.datetime` / `_dt.timedelta` used but `import datetime as _dt` missing (will break /api/web/admin/users + agent_admin endpoints once those code paths run). Backend logs confirmed historical NameError on web_panels/utils._current_year was already patched. Test suite saved as /app/backend/tests/test_refactor_regression.py.

critical_code_review_comments: AST-based extraction of the 5 monoliths missed module-level imports that were used in non-decorator code (function bodies). Each split file needs its own complete import block — `from . import *` in __init__.py only re-exports the router object, it does NOT propagate the parent module's globals to children. Recommend a final pass: for each split sub-module, run `python -c 'from routers.auth import core; print("ok")'` to surface NameErrors at import time, or wire them into an integration test that calls every endpoint at least once.

Pattern-level concern: at least 6 files share the SAME boilerplate header (logging, datetime, fastapi.Depends/HTTPException/Request, core.db, core.deps, core.security tuple, routers.notifications). Consider moving these into a `routers/auth/_common.py` (and equivalents) re-exported from each sub-module to eliminate the drift risk that caused this iteration's bugs.

Positive observations: package __init__.py re-export pattern is clean (TransferDraftIn / P2PTransferIn / etc. correctly re-exported for misc.py compat), wallet split (core/withdraw/p2p/recharge) works end-to-end, transfers split (core/auction/receipts) works including PDF generation, WebSocket helper `transfers.register_websocket(app)` correctly registers /api/ws/auction/{transfer_id} and /api/ws/agent.

rca_of_issue: Root cause: when auth.py / wallet.py / transfers.py / agent.py / web_panels.py monoliths were split into thematic packages, the AST extraction copied top-level decorator-bearing functions into per-domain files but did NOT recompute the import block needed by each split. The original monolith had one big `from core.security import (gen_id, hash_password, verify_password, create_access_token, gen_otp, create_reset_token, decode_token, is_weak_pin)` etc.; in the split files, only a subset of those symbols was re-imported, dropping the ones used in non-trivial endpoints (register/forgot-password/create-pin/agent-signup). Reproduction: hit any of the 3 failing endpoints and watch the server log — each shows a clean `NameError: name 'X' is not defined` at the offending line. Mitigation: per-file static analysis — running `python -c 'import compileall; compileall.compile_file("routers/auth/core.py")'` does NOT catch this (NameError is runtime), but `pyflakes routers/auth/*.py` or `ruff check routers/` would surface every undefined-name issue listed above. Recommend adding ruff to the pre-commit hook.
